name: Merit Based Award and Recognition Of High Performance In The Board Exams Of SSC And HSSC In The State Of Goa
benefit:
> **Felicitation of Rank Holders Students -** 1. ₹ 20,000/- to the First Five Rank Holders (separately for all the streams of Science, Commerce, Arts and Vocational). 1. A certificate of Appreciation will be given at the time of felicitation in the public function.
> **Merit-Based Awards -** 1. ₹ 5,000 awarded to the students who have scored 50% to 59.99% marks. 1. ₹ 8,000/- awarded to
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST) in the State of Goa.
1. The applicant should have secured 50% or above marks in the SSC/ HSSC Board exams.
1. (For Merit Based Award) The annual income of the family of the applicant should be less than ₹ 5,00,000/-.
